literal_meaning: ল্যাটিন শব্দ: ভাল বিশ্বাসে (in good faith)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দাবি বোনাফাইড বলে প্রমাণিত হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His claim was proven to be bona fide.
This is a bona fide contract.
history: Originated from Latin 'bona fides', meaning 'good faith', used in Roman law and adopted into English and Bengali formal contexts.
note: This is a transliterated Latin term commonly used in legal and official Bengali discourse.
